name: home-energy-dashboard
description: React + Cloudflare Pages dashboard for the home-energy-server API (same-origin Function proxy, API key never leaves the server side).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.functions.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.pages:dev: vite build && wrangler pages dev dist --port=8788
